summary: A snow weather: falling flakes, a white battlefield with wind-scoured drifts and churned mud, patchy snow on roofs, trees and the flat tops of vehicles.
rationale: Snow is above all a change of appearance. A wide view over a town in falling snow shows the whole look at once (flakes, drifted ground, roofs that differ, trees holding it in lumps, mountains in the haze); a close-up shows how a tank that has been fighting carries it (patches on the flat tops, a bare engine deck); and one matched sheet shows the same town and the same moment of a tank battle under the overcast sky and in snow. The flakes' drift and the shedding as a vehicle drives are described in text.

capture.renderer: Forward+ (Vulkan), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, 1600x900, off-screen window, the user's settings
capture.town: --aivai --seed=3 --mood=overcast / --mood=snow --nohud --focus-struct=town --shot-at=20; overcast from bd4f1b598ae80c6543cd4816e3f49a6ead730876, snow from this branch
capture.note: Each capture scaled to 798x448 and laid out 2x2 with OVERCAST / SNOW labels. The battle can differ slightly run to run. Compatibility renderer checked separately (--rendering-method gl_compatibility with forced vertex shading, the town and the tank close-up); not in the sheet.
